answer: The press house smells of crushed grapes, and the must runs dark into the vat. Proof of vintner via press screw tally — a press the vintner turns only after 26 presses run sweet from the vat, each press turned by the vintner himself. lotus turns the great screw slow, a quarter turn at a time. shale watches the juice run clear and stops before the pips break. timber measures each pressing and marks the barrel's head. A man faking it must press 26 vats that all run sweet, and the twenty-seventh still turns sour in the cask.
